== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A Goldsign is a physical manifestation or extra ability granted to [[sacred artists]] who have reached the [[Gold stage]] of [[advancement]]. This status is achieved by holding a [[Remnant]] within one's core, and the resulting Goldsign serves as a visible indicator of an individual's specific [[Path]]. These signs vary immensely in appearance and function, ranging from ornamental features like tattoos, halos, or wings to practical combat tools such as blades, claws, spikes, or elemental [[constructs]]. Some Goldsigns are integrated into the body, appearing as altered hair, facial features, or extra limbs, while others manifest as external objects like floating clouds, rings, or animals. The nature of a Goldsign is often tied to the artist's [[Path]] and their level of mastery. While some individuals possess standard signs associated with their lineage or sect, others may end up with non-standard or even disfiguring signs due to adopting unexpected [[Remnants]]. As an artist advances through the [[Gold]] ranks—from [[Lowgold]] to [[Highgold]] and eventually [[Truegold]]—they typically gain greater control over their Goldsign. Highly advanced [[Truegold|Truegolds]] can manipulate these manifestations with extreme subtlety or immense power, though the physical traits of a Goldsign may remain permanent regardless of further [[advancement]].}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|A Goldsign serves as a method to identify an individual's specific [[Path]] once they have reached the [[Gold stage]]. These marks manifest as miniature [[Remnant]] parasites located on a person's limbs, appearing in various forms such as a venom-green cloud over the head or a wrap around the wrist. While some Goldsigns are subtle, others are hideous physical features like a twisted, scarred face or a bright red circle on [[the hand]]. During combat, these marks can become active, as seen when [[Yerin's Goldsign]] flashed.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|A [[Goldsign]] is a way to tell who is on what [[Path]] at the [[Gold stage]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c2">''Soulsmith'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|A [[Goldsign]] is a miniature [[Remnant]] parasite on an individual's limb.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c3">''Soulsmith'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|A [[Goldsign]] can be a venom-green [[Remnant]] wrapped around a wrist or a cloud over a head.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c6">''Soulsmith'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|A [[Goldsign]] can be a physical feature like a scarred and twisted face.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c7">''Soulsmith'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|A [[Goldsign]] is a bright red circle on [[the hand]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c8">''Soulsmith'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|A [[Goldsign]] is a mark that can be subtle or hideous.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15">''Soulsmith'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Yerin's Goldsign]] flashed during combat.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c17">''Soulsmith'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|A Goldsign serves as a vital requirement for survival in the world and functions as a type of status or power level. While it can be possessed without a [[Remnant]], the term also refers to personal identifiers or marks like silver bracers. During her journey, [[Yerin's Goldsign]] was observed quivering and possessed the ability to blur silver. In contrast, Cassia utilizes a [[steel]] bracer known as a Goldsign.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias]] wears a [[steel]] bracer called [[Goldsign]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c8">''Blackflame'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Goldsigns are unique [[constructs]] capable of passing directly through armor plates. [[Yerin]] utilizes three distinct sets consisting of six Goldsigns in total, which she employs to cycle through various combat maneuvers. These Goldsigns manifest as [[steel]] blades growing from metal arms and can protrude from the back of her armor. While [[Yerin]] utilizes bladed versions for combat, [[Seishen Daji|Daji]] possesses a Goldsign breastplate.}}
